record.original_question: Let (X, omega) be a compact n-dimensional Kahler manifold, and let phi in E(X, omega) solve (omega + dd^c phi)^n = f omega^n where f is L^1 and smooth away from a divisor D subset X. Determine whether phi is smooth on X minus D.

evidence.quote: Question 22 (DiNezza-Lu). Let (X, omega) be a compact n-dimensional Kahler manifold. Assume phi in E(X, omega) solves the equation (omega + dd^c phi)^n = f omega^n, with f in L^1 being smooth off a divisor D subset X. Is the function phi smooth on X \ D?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$. Recall that a function $\varphi\colon X\to[-\infty,\infty)$ is $\omega$-plurisubharmonic if it is upper semicontinuous and $\omega+dd^c\varphi\ge 0$ as a current. The complex Monge–Ampère measure $(\omega+dd^c\varphi)^n$ is well defined for bounded $\omega$-plurisubharmonic functions by Bedford–Taylor, and its definition extends to the class $\mathcal{E}(X,\omega)$ of $\omega$-plurisubharmonic functions of full Monge–Ampère mass, characterized by the property that for the canonical decreasing approximants $\varphi_j:=\max(\varphi,-j)$ one has $\int_X(\omega+dd^c\varphi_j)^n\to\int_X\omega^n$.

Let $D\subset X$ be a (possibly reducible) divisor, and let $f\in L^1(X,\omega^n)$ be a non-negative function which is $C^\infty$ on $X\setminus D$. Suppose $\varphi\in\mathcal{E}(X,\omega)$ satisfies
$$(\omega+dd^c\varphi)^n \;=\; f\,\omega^n$$
on $X$ in the sense of pluripotential theory.

Question: must $\varphi$ be $C^\infty$ on $X\setminus D$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not turn up a definitive resolution of this regularity question for solutions in the full Monge–Ampère energy class $\mathcal{E}(X,\omega)$ when the right-hand side density is only $L^1$ and smooth off a divisor. There is active related work on stability and Hölder regularity of complex Monge–Ampère equations and on prescribed singularity types (Darvas–Di Nezza–Lu and others), but no source located here states that the question has been answered in full generality. Status reported as unknown.

status_evidence.snippet: Regularity results for complex Monge–Ampère equations on compact Kähler manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Related regularity progress exists but does not directly resolve the smoothness off the divisor question for L^1 densities in E(X,omega).

status_evidence.title: L^1-Stability for complex Monge–Ampère equations
status_evidence.snippet: Recent stability results for solutions of complex Monge–Ampère equations with L^1 right-hand side.
status_evidence.claim: Recent advances on L^1 right-hand side, but no explicit resolution of smoothness on X\D for E(X,omega) solutions found.
